results.title: Meteoric
results.overview: When an artist is hit by a meteor, the result is a “painting” that captivates the world. But the people want more.

results.title: Al Amal: A Journey of Hope
results.original_title: Al Amal: A Journey of Hope
results.overview: An animated short documentary crafted by people on the move in the refugee camp of the island of Lesbos (GR), following the story of Orhan, a Syrian Kurd who fled war with his family in 2013, seeking safety in Turkey—only to find that peace was still a distant dream.

results.title: The Male Gaze: Secrets and Lies
results.original_title: The Male Gaze: Secrets and Lies
results.overview: Escaping school bullies in Jerusalem, reconnecting with Dad in Indonesia, a missing baby at a drag show in Taiwan. All around the world, the language of telling lies and keeping secrets is common practice, but sometimes people's reasons for doing so may surprise you.

results.title: Não é Permitido: um recorte da censura ao Punk Rock no Brasil
results.original_title: Não é Permitido: um recorte da censura ao Punk Rock no Brasil

results.title: Our House Is on Fire
results.overview: Sofia, a promising young LA-based musician, returns to her home-town of Kyiv for the first time in four years. Her brother is getting married, the tables are heaving with food, everyone is there, including her ex-boyfriend. And then, suddenly, the sirens start wailing, and with the hangover comes the fight for survival.

results.title: Son of the Preacher
results.overview: Jasmine, a whip-smart beauty entrepreneur, dreams of launching her own haircare brand but can’t seem to catch a break. Enter Caleb Samuel — a social-media-famous preacher’s kid with millions of followers, a fast car, and complicated family expectations. What starts as a strategic business move quickly becomes a connection that challenges them both to face love, purpose, and legacy in ways they never expected.

results.title: Away
results.overview: Sergio, who has traveled to Utrecht with his family to attend a soccer match, suffers a panic attack just before taking the flight back to Barcelona.

results.title: Myocardium
results.overview: Pablo is in a crisis. In a morning when he hits rock bottom, his phone rings mysteriously. It's Ana, the girl who broke his heart more than fifteen years ago. Over the course of a day, Pablo will be able to resolve pending affairs and finish writing a chapter of his life... or maybe not...

results.title: Corpus Christi
results.overview: Adela, a woman with an undiagnosed mental illness, seeks relief through folk rituals. Misunderstood by her family and a medical system that offers her only medication, she lives convinced that someone, or something, is watching her. At times, she feels its presence: it touches her, hurts her, and leaves her bedridden for days. Only religion seems to offer her a sympathetic ear, leading her to consult a healer and confess the disturbing origin of her suffering.

results.title: My Dog Accidentally Turned Into a Human!
results.original_title: My Dog Accidentally Turned Into a Human!
results.overview: A lost kids' show on VHS "My Dog Accidentally Turned Into a Human!" following the adventures of Boy and Buster. In the episode "Firestarter," Boy and Buster have to work through their differences to start a fire. Will they be able to keep warm?

results.title: Wolf In Crown
results.overview: Steven, a troubled musician, seeks a doctor to quiet his restless mind while Sophia, an apparition and the love of his life, is haunted by dreams of a luminous city she once called home.

results.title: Dreamline
results.overview: After getting caught making a hip-hop beat with his friends instead of attending an important career networking event, a high school senior tries to find common ground with his father by sharing his original rap music.

results.title: Stardom 15th Goddesses of Stardom Tag League in Sapporo ~ Day 2
results.original_title: 第15回 ゴッデス・オブ・スターダム ～タッグリーグ戦～ in SAPPORO Day2
results.overview: 15th Goddesses of Stardom Tag League in Sapporo ~ Day 2 was a professional wrestling event promoted by World Wonder Ring Stardom. It took place on November 16, 2025, at Chateraise Gateaux Kingdom Sapporo in Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan, and served as the 7th show of the tournament's tour.

results.title: Pass and Goal
results.overview: Once a high-flying financial advisor, Hay Man loses everything and moves from her Deep Water Bay mansion to her cousin's modest home in "Deep Water Bo". Hoping to restore her fortune, she agrees to coach a scrappy U12 football team led by her cousin Ying and neighbourhood children for a league organised by a clueless rich heir. What begins as reluctant duty soon transforms into true mentorship, as Hay Man helps the kids confront struggles and regains her own sense of purpose. When the underdog team reaches the finals, she must choose between luxury past and newfound identity.

results.title: Hey, Hey, Take Care!
results.overview: Grief-striken in urban poor’s hell, a child eager for viral fame and his beautiful, terminal-ill brother embark on a rescue mission to take back a beloved family jeepney in order to survive.

results.title: My Magic Flute
results.overview: A cinematic experiment inspired by Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s music.

results.title: No Address
results.overview: A group of individuals who unexpectedly fall into homelessness. They bond together as an unconventional family, struggling to survive on the streets while warding off a harassing gang, an unforgiving community, and local authorities.
